name: A Feast for Buzzards

faq.answer: Watcher Cornelius is a watchman stationed at Terral's Watch.
Terral's Watch is a post manned by Watcher Cornelius near the remains.
The remains are too heavily weathered by the sun and chewed by teeth and claws to tell who died.
The deep markings gouged into the bones match the claw and tooth patterns of beasts.

sections.body: Out under the blazing sun lie the brittle, mangled bones of an unknown traveler. Deep gouges from teeth and claws score the limbs, leaving no clue who the person once was. Taking the gnawed skull to Watcher Cornelius at nearby Terral's Watch might uncover what brought them down.
sections.title: Bones in the Sun

sections.body: Watcher Cornelius traces the claw marks carved across the bone with growing dread. The grim discovery brings him trouble he wanted to avoid, dragging his post into whatever violence struck down the traveler.
sections.title: A Grim Burden

summary: A sun-bleached skeleton lies mangled by teeth and claws under the open sky. Taking the victim's gnawed skull to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch is the only way to learn who died here.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Feast for Buzzards
